title: Evolve and Search the News Schema
prompt: Add summaries, authors, indices, and FTS across two schema versions with exported schemas and tests from every supported version containing real bookmarks and queued writes.
successCriteria: FTS results handle documented language cases.
No unsupported path silently deletes data.
hints: Name the authoritative state and durable identity before selecting a library API.
Test the operation after cancellation, duplication, or process recreation.

starterCode.code: val MIGRATION_1_2: Migration = object : Migration(1, 2) { override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) { } }

solutionOutline: Model the data, operation, failure, and recovery states explicitly.
Implement the transactional path and prove every adverse success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic persistence or protocol tests.
Inspect durable state after interruption and retry.
